hints.title: Prime Sieve Generation
hints.text: Precompute primality up to right using a sieve array.

hints.title: Primes in Target Range
hints.text: Filter all primes in the interval [left, right] into a sorted list.

hints.title: Adjacent Prime Differences
hints.text: Compute differences between consecutive primes. If a difference of 1 or 2 is encountered, it is optimal and iteration can stop immediately.

hints.title: Sieve Range Prime Proximity Implementation

variables: R: upper range limit right up to 10^6
complexity.notes: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to R followed by linear scan over prime interval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Individually primality testing each number takes O(R * sqrt(R)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(R) memory for boolean sieve array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses Sieve of Eratosthenes and recognizes early exit on twin primes difference <= 2.
